description_full: Hafnia Limited., an investment holding company, owns and operates oil product tankers in Bermuda. It operates through Long Range II, Long Range I, Medium Range (MR), and Handy Size segments. The company transports clean and dirty, refined oil products, vegetable oil, and easy chemicals to national and international oil companies, and chemical companies, as well as trading and utility companies. It also engages in ship owning, chartering, and provision of maritime services in the product and chemical tankers market. The company was formerly known as BW Tankers Limited and changed its name to Hafnia Limited. In January 2019. Hafnia Limited was founded in 2010 and is based in Singapore.

financial_summary: Hafnia Limited is a mid-cap industrials business with a $5.1B market cap on $2.9B of annual revenue.
Returns on capital run at 26% against a 8% cost of capital — a 18-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat, with gross margins sitting at 48%.

The business throws off $981M in free cash flow — roughly 34 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.33× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, leverage is comfortably conservative at 0.8× net debt/EBITDA, and interest coverage of 15× is fortress-like.

Management returns a meaningful 13.6% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 43% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and within its sector the business captures 2.5× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
